name: Kilstine, Nebula Elemental
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : Each of your other creatures in battle zone gets +5000 power and has "blocker" and "double breaker".
flavorText: Kilstine led the Cooperative Assault Force across the clouds. The hunt for the Avatars had begun.

name: Extreme Crawler
rulesText:
When you put this creature into the battle zone, return all your other creatures from the battle zone to your hand.
Double breaker (When this creature breaks shield, it break 2 shields).
flavorText: "For thousands of years, our wisest scholars grappled with the question, 'How many tentacles is too many?' Turns out the answer is 5." — Uncanny Turnip

name: Necrodragon Jagraveen
rulesText:
Blocker (When opponent's creature attack, you may tap this card and block that attack, afterward, both creature battle).
When this creature blocks, destroy it after battles.
Double breaker (When this creature breaks shield, it break 2 shields).
flavorText: Its bones are made of steel. Its flames are made of hate.

name: Punch Trooper Bronks
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, destroy the creature that has the lowest power in the battle zone. If there's a tie, you choose from among the tied creatures.
flavorText: "Do you want mustard on your knuckle sandwich?"

name: Soul Phoenix, Avatar of Unity
rulesText:
(This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Vortex Evolution—Put on one of your Fire Birds and one of your Earth Dragons.
Triple breaker (This creature breaks 3 shields).
When this card would leave the battle zone, only the top card leaves the battle zone instead (Separate the other cards into 2 creatures).

name: Ularus, Punishment Elemental
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, for each creature you have in the battle zone, you may choose a shield and turn it face up. (Those shields stay face up while they're in the shield zone.)
flavorText: "Everyone who's been naughty gets a spanking! And just so we're clear, you've all been naughty!"

name: Cosmic Darts
rulesText: Your opponent chooses one of your shields. Look at it. If it's a spell, you may cast immediately for no cost. If it's not a spell or if you don't cast it, put it back where it was.
flavorText: "This is even more fun that Cosmic Tic-Tac-Toe!" — Pharzi, the Oracle

name: Typhoon Crawler
rulesText: This creature can't be attacked by fire or nature creatures.
flavorText: "If you go outside, bring a raincoat, an umbrella, and an anchor." — Wise Starnoid, Avatar of Hope

name: Meloppe
rulesText:
Whenever your opponent would choose one of your shields, you choose instead.
Whenever you would choose one of your opponent's shields, your opponent chooses instead.
flavorText: "That's not a pacifier, it's a brain stem interface. With a handle. That I suck on."

name: Gigavrand
rulesText: At the end of each turn, if your opponent drew 2 or more cards that turn, he discards his hand.
flavorText: "The specimen is particularly ruthless. Tests have shown that it has no 'ruth' whatsoever." — Meloppe

name: Steamroller Mutant
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : When this creature is put into battle Zone, destroy all creatures.
flavorText: The leaders of the Cooperative Assault Force realized that only extreme measures could stop the Avatars now.

name: Whirling Warrior Malian
rulesText: When another creature is put into battle zone, tap this creature.
flavorText: It doesn't get dizzy unless it stands still.

name: Mechadragon's Breath
rulesText: Choose a number less than or equal to 6000. Destroy all creatures that have that power.
flavorText: "Yes! After three long years of neverending work, my invention is a complete success! Now we can finally start the barbecue!" — Rikabu, the Dismantler

name: Pincer Scarab
rulesText:
This creature gets +2000 power for each card in your opponent's hand.
While this creature has power 6000 or more, it has "double breaker (this creature breaks 2 shields)."
flavorText: "Its pincers are so sharp, they can cut clouds in half." — Aura Pegasus, Avatar of Life

name: Radioactive Horn, the Strange
rulesText: Double breaker (When this creature breaks shield, it break 2 shields).
flavorText: The Fiona Woods - a natural wonderland conquered and corrupted by the forces of darkness - became the breeding ground for some of the freakiest creatures ever seen. No one could explain it, and everyone feared what might emerge next.

name: Agira, the Warlord Crawler
rulesText:
(This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Evolution—Put on one of your Gladiators or Earth Eaters.
Each of your other Gladiators and Earth Eaters in the battle zone gets +2000 power.
Whenever one of your Gladiators or Earth Eaters blocks, you may draw a card.

name: Hydrooze, the Mutant Emperor
rulesText:
(This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Evolution—Put on one of your Cyber Lords or Hedrians.
Each of your other Cyber Lords and Hedrians in the battle zone gets +2000 power.
Your Cyber Lords or Hedrians can't be blocked.

name: Phantomach, the Gigatrooper
rulesText:
(This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Evolution—Put on one of your Chimeras or Armorloids.
Each of your other Chimeras and Armorloids in the battle zone gain +2000 power.
Each of your Chimeras and Armorloids in the battle zone has "double breaker." (a creature that has "double breaker" breaks 2 shields.)

name: Nemonex, Bajula's Robomantis
rulesText:
(This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Evolution—Put on one of your Xeno Parts or Giant Insects.
Each of your other Xeno Parts and Giant Insects in the battle zone gets +2000 power.
Whenever any of your Xeno Parts or Giant Insects is attacking and isn't blocked, your opponent chooses a card in his mana zone, and puts it into his graveyard.

name: Comet Eye, The Spectral Spud
rulesText:
(This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Evolution—Put on one of your Wild Veggies or a Rainbow Phantoms.
Each of your other Wild Veggies and Rainbow Phantoms in the battle zone gets +2000 power.
At the end each of your turns, you may untap any number of your Wild Veggies and Rainbow Phantoms in the battle zone.

name: Valkyer, Starstorm Elemental
rulesText:
Blocker (When opponent's creature attack, you may tap this card and block that attack, afterward, both creature battle).
This creature can't attack players.
flavorText: "I fear no enemy. I fear no battle. I fear no sacrifice. I'm a little afraid of clowns, though."

name: Cloned Deflector
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
Choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone. Then, for each Cloned Deflector in each graveyard, you may choose another of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone. Tap all those creatures.

name: Cloned Spiral
rulesText: Choose a creature in battle zone. Then, for each Cloned Spiral in each graveyard, you may choose another creature in the battle zone. Return all those creature to their owner's hands.
flavorText: Once a week, the Cyber Lords pull the ocean's drain plug, flush out all the water, and refill it. It's their way of removing "impurities."

name: Enigmatic Cascade
rulesText: Discard any number of cards from your hand. Then draw that many cards.
flavorText: "The worst news can turn out to be the best news. Once you're at the bottom of the waterfall, there's nowhere you can fall from there." — Meloppe

name: Gigabalza
rulesText:
Shield Trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
When you put this creature into the battle zone, your opponent discards a card at random from his hand.
flavorText: "It comes in handy." — Necrodragon Jagraveen

name: Cloned Nightmare
rulesText: Choose a card at random from opponent's hand. Then, for each Cloned Nightmare in each graveyard, you may choose another card at random from opponent's hand. Your opponent discards all those cards.
flavorText: "You can't hide from yourself." — Death Phoenix, Avatar of Doom

name: Muramasa's Knife
rulesText: This creature can attack untapped creatures.
flavorText: "Ah, my finest creation! Not only is 80 percent of its body made of blades, it's got a corkscrew and a bottle opener as well!" — Muramasa, Duke of Blades

name: Cloned Blade
rulesText: Choose an opponent's creature in the battle zone that has power 3000 or less. Then, for each Cloned Blade in each graveyard, you may choose another opponent's creature in the battle zone that has power 3000 or less. Destroy all those creatures.
flavorText: "If you can avoid getting decapitated by it, it's totally fun to ride!" — Whirling Warrior Malian

name: Wingeye Moth
rulesText: Whenever your draw the card at the start of your turn, if one of your creatures in the battle zone has higher power then each of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone, you may draw an extra card.
flavorText: "Quick, someone get a 10-story flyswatter!" — Punch Trooper Bronks

name: Cloned Spike-Horn
rulesText:
This creature gets +3000 power for each Cloned Spike-Horn in each graveyard.
While this creature has power 6000 or more, it has "double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields)."
flavorText: The wisdom, the strength, and the anger of each generation is passed on to the next.

name: Electro Explorer Syrion
rulesText: (This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
flavorText: "Since he was fed up with being classified as a UFO - an unidentified flying object - I advised Syrion to introduce himself to every living being on the planet. Now that he's an IFO - an identified flying object - he gets invited to a lot more parties." — Wise Starnoid, Avatar of Hope

name: Sea Mutant Dormel
rulesText: (This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
flavorText: "The difference between reality and illusion is important to understand, except when you're in the middle of being squashed flat by a gigantic illusion. At that point it doesn't matter very much that it isn't real." — Cruel Naga, Avatar of Fate

name: Gigappi Ponto
rulesText: (This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
flavorText: "I like this planet. It's full of horrible little surprises. I was planning to destroy it in a fiery cataclysm of death, but maybe I'll do a little sightseeing first." — Death Phoenix, Avatar of Doom

name: Buzz Betocchi
rulesText: (This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
flavorText: "Buzz Betocchi is supposed to be my guide on this planet. Have you ever tried to have a conversation with someone whose language is half chirping and half buzzing? I gave up a week ago and just started wearing earplugs." — Soul Phoenix, Avatar of Unity

name: Spectral Horn Glitalis
rulesText: (This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
flavorText: "It has one of the most important jobs on the planet - it patrols rainbows. It checks the curvature, makes sure all the colors are in order, that sort of thing. Once orange went missing for a whole month, but Glitalis tracked it down. It always does." — Aura Pegasus, Avatar of Life

name: Bingole, the Explorer
rulesText: When this creature would be discarded from your hand during your opponent's turn, you may put it into the battle zone instead.
flavorText: "I thought it was a shooting star. . .until it changed direction." — Gigappi Ponto

name: Mizoy, the Oracle
rulesText: When you put this creature is put into the battle zone, you may choose a darkness or fire creature in the battle zone and tap it.
flavorText: "Plasmoparticles are disgusting. Electrification is freaky. Electrofied plasmoparticles? That's just crossing the line." — Death Phoenix, Avatar of Doom

name: Belmol, the Explorer
rulesText:
Blocker (When opponent's creature attack, you may tap this card and block that attack, afterward, both creature battle).
Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, this creature blocks if able.
This creature can't attack players.

name: Pharzi, the Oracle
rulesText: When this creature is destroyed, you may return a Spell from your graveyard to your hand.
flavorText: Its enemies paid no attention to it until it replaced its Silky Green Ribbon of Unimpressive Lameness with the Pretty Pink Ribbon of Whirling Devastation.

name: Tropic Crawler
rulesText:
Blocker (When opponent's creature attack, you may tap this card and block that attack, afterward, both creature battle).
Whenever this creature blocks, your opponent chooses one of his creatures in the battle zone, and returns it to his hand.
This creature can't attack.

name: Funky Wizard
rulesText:
Blocker (When opponent's creature attack, you may tap this card and block that attack, afterward, both creature battle).
When you put this creature into the battle zone, each player may draw a card.
flavorText: "Let's boogie!"

name: Wily Carpenter
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, draw up to 2 cards. Then discard 2 cards from your hand.
flavorText: "I specialize in making the final cut on a boat before it's finished. It's usually in the form of a circular hole in the bottom of the hull. . . ."

name: Frantic Chieftain
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, return one of your creatures that costs 4 or less from the battle zone to your hand.
flavorText: "Do you know how hard it is to find feathers underwater? Very few birds fly down here!"

name: Necrodragon Zalva
rulesText: When this creature is put into battle zone, your opponent draws a card.
flavorText: It feeds on pain and suffering. Actually, since it went on a diet, it feeds on lite-pain and fat-free suffering substitute.

name: Gigarayze
rulesText: When you put this card into the battle zone, your may return a water or fire creature from your graveyard to your hand.
flavorText: "Life is not the only fragile, random thing on earth. Look at death, for example." — Cruel Naga, Avatar of Fate

name: Windmill Mutant
rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks, you opponent discards a card at random from his hand.
flavorText: "I'm bored. Bored, bored, bored. Hold on, I've got a crazy idea - for the rest of the day, I'm gonna spin counterclockwise!"

name: Gigaslug
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
Slayer (Whenever this creature battles, destroy the other creature after the battle.)
This creature can't attack.
flavorText: Sometimes it has starting contests with itself. It never wins.

name: Flame Trooper Goliac
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : When you put this creature is put into battle zone, destroy one of your opponent's creatures that has power 5000 or less.
flavorText:
Step 1: Blast everything in sight.
Step 2: If necessary, think of a Step 2.

name: Hypersprint Warior Uzesol
rulesText:
Speed Attacker (This creature doesn't get Summoning Sickness).
Power attacker +4000 (While attacking, this creature gets +4000 power).
flavorText: "It's amazing - it's faster than the speed of time!" — Soul Phoenix, Avatar of Unity

name: Peppi Pepper
rulesText: Power attacker +3000 (While attacking, this creature gets +3000 power).
flavorText: "My primary weapon is extreme cuteness. But if I don't cute my enemies to death, the waves of blistering flames are a good backup."

name: Gandaval's Stapler
rulesText: Whenever another creature is put into the battle zone, tap this creature.
flavorText: "It can staple trees, rocks, tanks, skyscrapers, diamonds, battleships, missles, cows, bridges, mutant cows, other staplers, and mutant zombie cows. Just about everything but paper, really." — Armored Raider Gandaval

name: Copper Locust
rulesText: When a player evolves another creature, destroy this creature.
flavorText: Its exoskeleton has an exoskeleton.

name: Turtle Horn, the Imposing
rulesText: Whenever your opponent uses the "shield trigger" ability of one of his shields, search your deck. You may take a creature from your deck, show that creature to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.
flavorText: "It's amazing - it's slower than the speed of time!" — Soul Phoenix, Avatar of Unity

name: Fever Nuts
rulesText: Your creatures and your opponent's creatures each cost up to 1 less to summon. They can't cost less than 1.
flavorText: "We're not crazy. . . we're nuts!!!"

name: Uncanny Turnip
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : When you put this creature into the battle zone, put the top card of your deck into your mana zone. Then put a creature from your mana zone into your hand.
flavorText: "Most turnips can't see the future. Most turnips don't wear a cape."

name: Terradragon Arque Delacerna
rulesText:
Double Breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields).
When this creature would be discarded from your hand during your opponent's turn you may put it into the battle zone instead.
flavorText: "Are we being attacked by a Dragon, or did a garden just explode?" — Hydrooze, the Mutant Emperor

name: Wise Starnoid, Avatar of Hope
rulesText:
(This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Vortex Evolution—Put on one of your Light Bringers and one of your Cyber Lords.
Whenever this creature attacks or leaves the battle zone, add the card on top of your deck to your shields face-down.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields).

name: Cruel Naga, Avatar of Fate
rulesText:
(This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Vortex Evolution—Put on one of your Merfolks and one of your Chimeras.
This creature can't be blocked.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields).
When this creature leaves the battle Zone, destroy all creatures in the battle Zone.

name: Death Phoenix, Avatar of Doom
rulesText:
(This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Vortex Evolution—Put on one of your Zombie Dragons and one of your Fire Birds.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields).
Whenever this creature would break a shield, your opponent puts that shield into his graveyard instead.
When this creature leaves the Battle Zone, you opponent discards his hand.

name: Aura Pegasus, Avatar of Life
rulesText:
(This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Vortex Evolution—Put on one of your Horn Beasts and one of your Angel Commands.
Whenever this creature attacks or leaves the battle zone, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a non-evolution creature, put it into battle zone. Otherwise, put it to your hand.
Triple breaker (This creature breaks 3 shields).
